scope: Strength of all ten existing StudioOpticsUITests repeatability methods and the actual model-backed optics controls under m02-m03-code-v2. No physical calibration, AR expansion, readiness/budget changes, or current CI reconciliation.

checks.detail: Exactly ten named XCTest methods each call the same runOpticsEditingUndoRedoAndRelaunch implementation. This is ten independent repetitions of one workflow, as the repeatability names and contract require, rather than ten distinct optics scenarios.

Each invocation constructs XCUIApplication with -ui-testing, en/en_US and a newly generated UUID KEYFILL_UI_TEST_ID. ProjectStore uses that UUID in its app-private test directory; StudioPreferences uses the same UUID in its isolated defaults suite. The same application object/environment is retained across terminate/launch within a case, so persistence reloads the same fixture. Different methods do not reuse saved projects or unit preferences. Isolation is DEBUG-gated.

The test selects Rectangular softbox, asserts its value, exactly one emitterWidth native slider, label Width in meters and initial value 0.6 m. It adjusts width, waits for a changed readout and enabled Undo, then asserts a nontrivial edited value before undo/redo checks. This prevents no-op width edits from passing the round trip.

The width accessibility value is model-backed: StudioTrackingSlider.accessibilityValue reads editing.read(); OpticsInspector supplies DistanceValueButton.formattedValue; StudioView binds optics to the light identified by UUID, validates optics and writes scene.lights[i].optics. It does not use UIKit percent text as the expected model value.

Undo must be enabled/hittable and restores the captured initial width while preserving Rectangular softbox, explicitly rejecting undo of the preceding emitter selection. Redo must be enabled/hittable and restores the exact captured edited-width readout. Optics menu and slider edits feed StudioView's shared owner-scoped SceneEditHistory.

Save taps the real saveProject control and waits for Saved locally before terminating. StudioView assigns saved only after await store.perform(request) and adoption of the result; ProjectStore performs the real library save. Relaunch waits for Saved locally then checks both persisted emitter kind and width, so default scene reconstruction alone cannot satisfy the edited-width assertion.

The normalized 0.5 gesture is approximate input, intentionally not an exact midpoint oracle. Exact comparisons apply to initial 0.6 m and captured model readouts after Undo, Redo and reload. StudioNumericInput.formattedValue uses the stored Double's round-trip digits rather than a rounded compact display. Tests do not claim exact UIKit finger placement or photometric accuracy.

conclusion: No new concrete defect identified in the requested source/test-strength scope. The ten methods contain meaningful model-backed change, undo/redo and persistence assertions with independent storage scopes. Their supported claim is repeatability of this emitter-kind/width workflow, not complete optics or scene invariant coverage.
